title: Rabbi Ulla of Caesarea
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim, chapter 3, at the end of halakhah 2 (supplied סה״ב), and Niddah 2:7, R. Yaakov bar Acha (in the name of) R. Ulla of Caesarea, in the name of R. Chanina. He lived approximately in the second generation of the Amoraim of the Land of Israel.

notes.text: The parenthesized “in the name of” is already in the supplied Hebrew. The approximate generational dating remains Hyman’s.

The consulted Pesachim and Niddah passages name Jacob bar Acha, Ulla of Caesarea and Rabbi Chanina. The first “in the name of” is parenthetical in Hyman. The historical review records a different OCR reading for the Niddah halakhah number. The generation estimate is Hyman’s.
